bifrost: springboard/src/media/ (shell-internal player, demux, decoders, mixer), springboard/audiod/src/main.rs, springboard/src/shell/audiosvc.rs
summary: BifrOSt has a working media stack (MP4/WebM demux, VA-API/ffmpeg video decode, AAC/MP3 audio, ALSA output, A/V sync, ID3/ilst tags), but it is inside the shell and Music app, not an SDK API. Nothing exists for compositions, video effects, export or writing media. A read-only movie summary (springboard/src/media/movie.rs) lists duration and tracks for a file.

features.bifrost: springboard/src/media/demux/mod.rs, springboard/src/media/id3.rs, springboard/src/media/ilst.rs; wired: springboard/apps/podcasts-desktop/src/info.rs (episode length and codec info for the sheet; still partial, no asset object, chapters or artwork); springboard/ui/src/av_asset.rs (asset load of duration and tracks from WAV)
features.note: Demux and tag reading exist (MP4, WebM, ID3, ilst) but are shell-internal; no asset or track object for apps Wired into the UI in wiring wave 4 (0.5.41); verify on Midget for parity. Round sprint10/6: asset object with duration and tracks (WAV) in bifrost_ui::av_asset; partial, needs a Midget check.

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 14 tests. Wave 5 (w5-avfoundation-playback-editing, parity/integration 93f283b0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. Reading samples is internal to the player; no writer, no export, no frame-grab API
verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 12 tests. File type identification exists; no captions or subtitle model

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 6 tests. Wave 4 (w4-avfoundation-playback-editing, parity/integration 0925691e): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. Decode only, no encoder settings
Sample format conversion exists internally; no settings dictionary
Play, pause, seek, buffering and A/V sync work, but only through the shell (Deildu, Files video); apps get no SDK player. No looper, interstitials or rate control
VA-API hardware decode with libavcodec fallback; no frame-output API for apps
audiod and mixer own output and routing; no app-facing session API
Play, pause, skip and scrub mapping is tested headless (headless_now_playing_* in springboard/tests). Music integrates with the shell; widgets::player draws the mini player (docs/bifrost-ui.md)
Progressive streaming to a growing file for playback; no HLS download tasks or storage policy
verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 2 tests. HTTP sources and MSE demux exist; no HLS, AirPlay or DRM

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 6 tests. Wave 1 (parity/integration 0d0412c3): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No composition model

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 6 tests. Wave 4 (w4-avfoundation-playback-editing, parity/integration 0925691e): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No transitions, custom compositor or layer-animation tool

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 6 tests. Wave 1 (parity/integration 0d0412c3): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. A system mixer exists; no per-track volume ramps over an asset

gaps: No SDK media player for apps (everything is in the shell crate)
No SDK asset model for apps: springboard/src/media/movie.rs summarizes a movie inside the shell crate only, and there is no sample reader for apps.
No composition, video composition or audio mix editing
No writer or export session; no encoder
No HLS, offline download management, AirPlay or FairPlay
No sample buffer renderers or synchronizer
